reviews.comment: Was reflecting on all the classes I took at A&M and this was by far the single biggest waste of time, energy, and effort. The class doesn't *teach* you anything new since 6th grade. I remember this one class was just looking at the color wheel for an hour. Another time it was thinking about very obvious emotions in a piece of writing.Take it at CC!
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Very accessible outside of class, and she is very understanding of any circumstances that may interfere with your ability to turn in something by the deadline. Lots of discussions, and the second half of the course is two group projects. No exams. All 4 blocks weighted equally in final grade. It was a lot of work for a 200 level course though.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment:
Great Person, not so much as a Prof: Class Load was very light but she didnt grade majority of the assignments till the day before. 

Most Assignments did not even have a rubric and unclear grading, and were pretty pointless busy-work. Really wanted to like the prof, but did not learn anything new or insightful in the class.

She is so sweet and gives really good feedback. Its not a super hard class, the essays are a little daunting, but she does give feedback for the essay proposals, and the reading responses fill out a good amount of points. attendence is mandatory, however the amount of abences allowed was a bit higher than my usual mandatory classes.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Be prepared for her to make unnecessary comments about Christianity. It's unprofessional, especially considering that most of the texts we study are deeply rooted in it. How am I supposed to take the analysis seriously when they insult the very foundation of the works we're reading? A professor should foster discussion, not belittle the influences.

I LOVE HAGSTROM-SCHMIDT!!! She was such a great professor that didn't ask for much. She is very clear in her instructions and her class is so easy as long as you listen and do what is asked of you. She is VERY caring and probably the nicest professor I've ever taken. The class is small so you have more chances at connecting with your peers.

Thorough but an extremely slow grader. Some papers were not graded until more than a month after the due date, which is a good part of a semester. Great at facilitating in-class discussions, which were very interesting and enjoyable. The small class size in the honors section led to closer relationships and comfortable talks.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Genuinely one of the best professors I've ever taken, she is SO caring and down to earth. Her grading is super clear of what she expects and understands that life happens. The only negative thing I have to say is that she is not the quickest to grade things, but she does grade easy. Show up to class, do your work, and you will get an A.

Dr. Hagstrom-Schmidt is a great professor with a big heart. If I could take her for my other English classes I would! My only negative is she takes awhile to grade things but that is to be expected with English classes. She is passionate about what she teaches and is a fair grader. Take her!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: I took the small honors-only Shakespeare class. It was amazing. I will say one thing - you don't actually have to read the plays. I mostly just watched movie versions of them. Some papers throughout, but easy 100s.
She is a great professor and has taught really well, the only problem I have is the slow grading but usually, she grades fairly well

Dr. H is a very nice woman who enjoys her job very much. ENGL 104 is an easy class, and although she assigns lots of readings for homework, you do not actually need to read them. Attendance is mandatory. She is not at all prompt in grading assignments or returning rough drafts with feedback, and so that is extremely difficult and frustrating.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Graded by few things--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: She cares too much. The work is not that important, and you do not become a better writer.
Amazing lady, literally love her. Just know that the course requires a lot of reading before each class. Also, she's an easy grader, is reasonable, and so so kind. Highly recommend taking her!!!
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Caring

reviews.comment: She is nice, I went to her office hours a couple times to check over my work. She is a lenient grader as well. The problem with the class is that there is a discussion post every Friday and replies are due the following Monday. My one complaint about her is sometimes she releases these discussions the day of and you have to scramble to get it done.

This a writing class, so there were a lot of papers and discussion posts. Sometimes the course load felt excessive but the professor was pretty clear on what instructions and deadlines to follow. A little slow on grading but overall she was very structured, understanding, provided feedback when requested, and I would recommend for English 210.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Clear grading criteria--So many papers

reviews.comment: So much work to do in this class. Every week is two forums with some project. Forums basically participation but projects were pretty much all graded right at the end of the semester. Since most of the projects are based on one big project, it was tough to get genuine feedback. Wanted to become a better writer but instead, it was all busywork.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Lots of homework--So many papers

reviews.comment: This class was asynchronous which I actually prefer. A lot of papers to write, but this would be the case no matter which professor you have. Dr. H is responsive to emails and will help you & answer your questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--So many papers--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: While she is considerate w her assignments, this class is ONLY busywork assignments-nothing was taught. 1-3 papers due every week. Such a slow grader. Stuff I turned in in Feb has not been graded yet in may. Gives little to no feedback on stuff that has been graded. If you want to save yourself from constant writing busywork, take somewhere else.

Attendance not mandatory, but for full credit you need to submit the make-up assignments. Easy class, great prof! She was very understanding and able to give more feedback if requested. She will match your interest level; if you want more out of the class, she can provide it for you and will work closely with you to succeed. Love Dr. H!

As someone who has always struggled with writing, Dr. H made it seem like a piece of cake. She lays out exactly what she is expecting and will answer any questions you have. Although the recommendation report is a huge project, she spans it over a couple of weeks to make the workload manageable. Feedback on writing is very helpful.

Best English professor I've had at A&M. I would recommend her to anyone taking ENGL210. She is super caring, funny, and you know exactly what is expected of you. There are papers due every Monday that lead up to one big report but it is very doable since it is broken done into chunks. PLEASE take her you will love her!

THE BEST. EVER!!! I wish I could take her for every class in my entire degree. I will never forget Dr.H. I looked forward to class, and despite it being writing intensive, she makes it an amazing experience. Dr.H has such a warm, caring personality that you cant NOT love her. Take her class if you need ENGL 210!

She was awesome! Since it was online and in the summer, I never got to meet with her in person, but she was always willing to help when I had questions. She hasn't graded many assignments yet though. Overall, super sweet and would take again!

Easiest English class I have ever taken. She is very nice, gives great feedback, and grades reasonably. The group assignments are long but are easy since it is broken up with teammates. Would highly recommend it for people looking for a class that will only take a max two hours per week.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Lots of homework--Clear grading criteria

reviews.comment: Dr. H is one of the BEST professors at TAMU. She genuinely cares about her students and is incredibly understanding about everyone's situations. She's really passionate about the material and made me look forward to attending an 8 AM. Gives great feedback, is really helpful, and makes learning fun. I would 100% take her again!

I'm a STEM major that hates English classes, but I loved this class with Dr. Hagstrom. She's super nice and extremely helpful in office hours. Definitely take advantage of her office hours to get help/pointers. She grades super fairly and gives amazing feedback on writing assignments. One of my favorite professors overall!

The most accommodating and caring prof I've ever had. COVID completely disrupted our class and Nicole proved she cared about our safety and education. The class requires time/hard work but you will learn. Her feedback is awesome, I used it to apply to jobs as a recent grad. This pandemic has truly shown every prof's true colors and Nicole is a gem.

AMAZING PROFESSOR! While the majority of your grade comes from papers, she was always willing to help read over your paper beforehand and give feedback. Her lectures were great and honestly made learning about Shakespeare enjoyable.

She is such a nice person and really helped me learn and understand the writings of Shakespeare. While we did read A LOT of his plays we would go over them in class and she explained the things we did not understand or did not get. I would def take a class from her again.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Nicole is honestly the best English professor Ive ever had. She was very clear with her grading criteria, and even offered extra credit and gave us second chances on the writing of some of our papers. Her classes are always very fun, and she really makes sure everyone understands what theyre learning. Definitely take her if you get the chance!
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Caring--Get ready to read

reviews.comment: Nicole was hands down one of the best English professors I've ever had. We had a quiz almost every day so attendance is important. Her lectures were AMAZING and informational. She does require a lot of reading before every class but they're usually entertaining. She makes herself accessible a lot outside of class which is SO helpful for the essays.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Get ready to read--Hilarious

reviews.comment: The class can be time-consuming and is obviously heavy on the writing component but Hagstrom-Schmidt is a really great prof. She gives great advice on all writing assignments turned in and grades very fairly.

Professor Schmidt is without question one of the best professors at TAMU! She can be a tough grader-- but it is always called for and her feedback helped improve my essays and overall grade. There is a lot of required reading, and some of the essays require research but overall this course was a blast! 10 out of 10 would recommend!

She is a very nice teacher and likes her job a lot, it is important to show up every day and contribute to her discussions. There are three major papers which she lets you have a lot of freedom on what you can write about, but her guidelines are clear. Get to know her because she is very nice.
